yaw_correction_gain.description: Fraction of the observed yaw discrepancy folded into the estimate per update.  Distinct from localization.toml, which tunes the LIDAR pose *search*: this is the dead-reckoning blend, and it runs whether or not localization is enabled. Deliberately small -- the IMU is the only absolute heading reference the robot has, so a hot gain lets a single bad correction drag the heading, and corridor_estimator files every width reading by heading.
